featured_reviews.name: A N
featured_reviews.review_text:
'24 by 7 One stop pharmacy and many more'

Yup you hear right about rite, once we entered the shop will get idea what I'm talking about. Apart from medicine one can get bakery items and dairy products like cold drinks, wafers, variety of chocolates, hair oil, cream and many more. Medicine are provided by them on good discount rate. Staff is very supportive and knowledgeable as well. Easy to locate shop on chincholi bunder road, will get required item easily once you start roaming inside. Apart from medicine you'll get other required item like massager, wheel chair etc on order. Shop remain open day and night so its plus point to whom who required eatable and medicine items urgent basis.

featured_reviews.name: Joel Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
BEWARE !! WORST managed Pharmacy at Thunga Hospital Malad !!

The chemist service at Thunga Hospital Malad is HORRIFYING. Patient care seems to be of little concern to the staff, who often appear disinterested & preoccupied with other tasks. Even during emergencies, they do not respond promptly.

Furthermore, there have been instances of overcharging for medical instruments used within the hospital, taking advantage of their proximity to the hospital's facilities. Billing errors are also a common occurrence, with patients or their relatives receiving follow-up calls for additional payments due to the chemist's mistakes.

It is advisable to exercise caution when purchasing medicines or medical instruments from this pharmacy.
